body_excerpt:
In the Linux kernel, a use-after-free issue was resolved in the eventpoll subsystem. In some situations, ep_free() could free an eventpoll structure while another thread was still using it. The fix defers freeing that structure until after an RCU grace period, preventing the use-after-free.
